description: Implementation of the WindowSurfaceWGL class for managing WGL window surfaces in OpenGL on Windows, including pixel format setup, buffer swapping, and surface properties.

classes.name: WindowSurfaceWGL
classes.description: WGL implementation of egl::Surface for Windows, managing pixel formats, buffer swapping, and surface properties.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WGL window surface, sets pixel format, and determines swap behavior.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers for the window surface.

methods.name: setSwapInterval
methods.description: Sets the swap interval for buffer swapping.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the window surface.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the window surface.
